title: Vibrant Crispy Korean Tofu Dumplings
description: A garlicky and crispy Korean dish featuring soy milk and leaf-wrap-steam, perfect for meal prep and FODMAP-friendly diets
instructions: In a blender, combine soy milk, garlic, sesame oil, rice vinegar, Gochujang, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth
In a large bowl, combine the crumbled tofu and the blended mixture, and mix until well combined
Lay a napa cabbage leaf flat on a work surface, and place about 1 tablespoon of the tofu mixture in the center of the leaf
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder
Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling
In a large skillet, heat about 1/2 inch of sesame oil over medium-high heat
When the oil is hot, add a few of the dumplings to the skillet, being careful not to overcrowd
Cook the dumplings for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are crispy and golden brown
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a drizzle of soy sauce
